articles.title: U.S. Army, Colombian senior military leaders conclude Fort Bragg engagements

articles.title: U.S. Naval War College commemorates 80th anniversary of USS Missouri battleship visit to Istanbul
articles.summary: A delegation from the U.S. Naval War College visited Istanbul, Turkiye, to commemorate the 80th anniversary of the landmark 1946 visit by the battleship USS Missouri - a visit that was held to repatriate the body of the late Turkish ambassador, and would go on to be seen as the launch of a new era of U.S.-Turkiye bilateral relations.
